title: Measure the performance of public children services agencies
subject: Child Welfare
Juvenile and Family Law
State and Local Government

abstracts.abstract: To amend sections 2151.011, 2151.412, 2151.421, 2151.424, 2152.72, and 5180.41; to enact sections 5180.408, 5180.409, 5180.4010, 5180.4011, 5180.4012, 5180.4013, 5180.412, 5180.413, and 5180.414; and to repeal section 2151.429 of the Revised Code to establish the Child Welfare County Performance and Accountability Initiative to measure the performance of public children services agencies and to make other changes regarding child welfare.

other_titles.title: To amend sections 2151.011, 2151.412, 2151.421, 2151.424, 2152.72, and 5180.41; to enact sections 5180.408, 5180.409, 5180.4010, 5180.4011, 5180.4012, 5180.4013, 5180.412, 5180.413, and 5180.414; and to repeal section 2151.429 of the Revised Code to establish the Child Welfare County Performance and Accountability Initiative to measure the performance of public children services agencies and to make other changes regarding child welfare.
